main_text.p: Elias Levita, copulam ו ante ה interrogativum poni: Vide in פתח amplius: פתיתני Pellexisti me, Jer.20.7. Partic. מפתיה Pellectūrus sum eam, Hos.2.14. ubi est ' loco tertia radicalis ה, quae aliàs folet abjici. Pyh. Futur. יפתה Pellectus fuerit, Ezech.14.9. יפתה קצין Pellicietur princeps, Prov.25.15. Hiph.Futur. per Apocopam, יפת Dilatet, juxta Paraphrasten Chaldaum & plerosq; Hebræos, Gen.9.27. Nam ita hoc Verbum Chaldæus usurpatur. Quidam Alliciet, sc. ut suo tempore ad cultum Dei & tento-ria Sem, id est, Ecclesiam accedat.
פתה m. Simplex, Fatuus, Imperitus, qui facilè pellicitur & blanditiis seducitur, Job.5.2. ולפתה שפתי Et simplici labiis suis, Prov.20.19. Fœmin. פתה יונה Columba simplex, fatua, Hos.7.11.
פתי m. Idem: Et substantivè, Fatuitas, Simplicitas, Prov.1.22. Plural. פתיים Fatui, Psal.1.22. pro פתיים ut sequitur: פתיים Simplices, Prov.116.130. Et cum Epenthesi א, פתאים Prov.9.6.
פתיא m. Chald. Latitudo: Aff. פתיה Latitudo ejus, Esræ 6.3.

פתח Aperuit: Metaphoricè, Solvit, Retexit, Pandit, Explicavit: Strinxit, cum de gladio dicitur. Praeterit. פתח Solvebat, Jesa.14.17. ופתחת Et aperies, 2.Regum 9.3. &c. Niph. Praeter. נפתח Solvetur, Jesa.5.27. נפתחו Aperti sunt, Ezech.1.1. Partic. נפתח Apertus, Zach.13.1. Infinit. להפתח Ad solvendum, Jes.51. v.14. Futur. יפתח Aperietur, Ezech.44.2. Pih. פתח Aperuit, Solvit, Sculpsit, Infculpsit: Sulcavit: Praeter. פתח Solvit, Job.30.11. Et intransitive, פתח Aperuit se prima uva, Cant.7.12. quasi pro passivo פתח positum; & sic accipiendum tradunt Jesa.48.8. & 69.11. ופתח Cum

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points are largely omitted in this transcription; consonantal forms are copied as seen. Doubtful readings: "Prov.116.130" (possibly Psal.), the Hebrew forms in the first entry and the last Hebrew form before "Cum", and the reference Jes.51 v.14 (printed as such). The column ends mid-entry at "Cum" and continues on the next page. Large Hebrew root word at the start of the entry is set in larger type and is not a heading.
